code='''def transform(grid):
    cells = {}

        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v:
                cells.setdefault(v, []).append((r, c))
    objects = []
    for color, pts in cells.items():
        r0 = min(r for r, c in pts); r1 = max(r for r, c in pts)

        objects.append((color, shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    h = max(len(shape) for _, shape in objects)
    out = [[] for _ in range(h)]
    for i, (_, shape) in enumerate(objects):
        w = len(shape[0])
        for r in range(h):
            out[r].extend(shape[r] if r < len(shape) else [0] * w)

    return out
'''
